facts.fact: Leah 说深海一直到最底下都有东西在动，没有空无一物的地方。
facts.anchor: “The ocean is unstill,” she says, “further down than you think. All the way to the bottom, things move.”

facts.fact: Leah 回来后两人改成晚上并排坐在沙发上，Miri 改为站在厨房吃饭以免弄脏。
facts.anchor: so I prefer to eat mine standing up in the kitchen to save on mess

facts.fact: Leah 早上六点醒来就流鼻血，Miri 递给她一块法兰绒布并开龙头，叫她别把头往后仰。
facts.anchor: At around six this morning, Leah woke and immediately had a nosebleed.

facts.fact: Miri 替 Leah 打电话给 Centre，只为要到她的 personnel number。
facts.anchor: the whole purpose of my calling the Centre has been to try to get hold of it

facts.fact: Leah 把 Miri 的手从脸上推开，用近乎熟练的动作说自己没事，并说 Miri 慌乱中穿上的鞋不配对。
facts.anchor: She pushed my hands from her face in a manner that seemed almost practised and told me it wasn’t a problem.

facts.fact: Leah 刚回来流血时，Miri 一边惊慌一边硬套上鞋，要求带她去急诊（A&E）。
facts.anchor: jammed my shoes on and demanded she let me take her to A&E

facts.fact: Miri 输入除 personnel number 之外的所有号码，第三个录音声音随即训斥她并宣布挂断电话。
facts.anchor: I enter all the details required, aside from the personnel number, at which point a third recorded voice comes on the line and proceeds to scold me in a tight robotic jabber, noting as a helpful afterthought that my call will now be terminated.

numbers.anchor: It’s three o’clock and I’m tilting the phone receiver away from my ear
